text:
liz: Heads up — noticed invoice-preview spikes / missing tokens for a handful of tenants after routing backoffs around 17:12 UTC. Preview shows "pending" counts but invoices later include those tokens. Example tenant t-1223. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/metering?view=tenant&t=t-1223 :eyes:

mohit: Which preview id / sample event? can you paste a raw event?

liz: sample event (sanitized):
```
{"tenant":"t-1223","trace_id":"abc123","event_type":"usage","tokens":42,"route":"fallback-v2","status":"pending","ingest_state":null}
```

alyssa: This smells like the backoff change we rolled yesterday (metering-backoff v2). I saw `backoff_count` increments in the batcher logs. :thinking:

oncall-joe: Confirmed — us-west2 batcher showed spikes and repeated `requeue` entries. pattern: `rate_limit -> backoff -> requeue -> backoff`. ack path sometimes didn't flip `ingest_state` to `ingested`. logs: `metering.batch.requeue tenant=t-1223 reason=rate_limit attempts=3`

console-team-bot: deploy-bot: rolled metering-backoff v2 -> v1 rollback at 17:20 UTC (triggered by alert metering.backoff.spike) :information_source:

mohit: Hypothesis: consumer that marks invoice-ready reads `event_status` field but our backoff path leaves `event_status` null and moves to pending queue. mapping mismatch between ingest pipeline and invoice finalizer.

alyssa: If true, we should add metrics asap: `metering.pending_count` (per-tenant, per-route) and a tag `backoff_reason` with values like `rate_limit|conn_err|kv_lease`. that'll let us graph pending->ingested transitions.

liz: Console UX idea: surface ingested vs pending in invoice preview. small badge: "pending: 123 / ingested: 456" and an alert if pending > 500 for > 5m. customers keep seeing preview drift and panic. cc @console-team

billing-qa: We need deterministic behaviour in preview vs final invoice. flaky previews are causing support tickets. Propose a feature flag: `ui.show_pending_in_preview` (default false) so we can hide noisy pending counts until stable.

mohit: Plan: 1) instrument `metering.pending_count` + `backoff_reason` 2) quick fix mapping in the finalizer to respect `ingest_state` (canary 1% us-west) 3) console flag behind FF + small UX tweak. rollout steps and alarms in RFC. I'll file RFC after triage.

liz: Action items: mohit - RFC + canary mapping change; alyssa - add metrics and make Grafana panels (pending vs ingested heatmap); console-team - add feature flag and UI badge mock; oncall-joe - deep-dive consumer ack path & attach requeue logs. I'll schedule 15m sync at 17:45 UTC.

oncall-joe: attaching quick grep of requeue window and a short grok pattern in case it's useful: `metering.batch.requeue tenant=%s reason=%s attempts=%d`. I'll upload logs to the incident ticket.

incident-bot: created INC-2026-504 for invoice-preview drift (linked dashboards + runbook).

liz: Thanks all. Let's avoid broad rollouts until metrics/flag are in place. :thumbsup:
